title: Retained review attempts lose their start and end times: only the latest attempt's timing is readable
outcome: A parent can read when each retained review attempt of a delegation started and finished, not only the latest one, without reading internal mail.
acceptance: termal_get_session_result for a retained submission attempt returns that attempt's started and completed times.
Earlier attempts' times remain readable after later attempts run, shown by a behaviour test with at least two attempts.
